'''Fiyr Shades''' are [[undead]] [[spectral]] creatures that lurk behind the silver door in the [[Mort'ton]] [[Shade Catacombs|shade catacombs]] dungeon. They initially appear as black moving shadows on the ground and then rise from the depths to attack. On occasion they have also been known to leave their catacombs to attack [[Temple Trekking|trekkers]] and [[Burgh de Rott Ramble|ramblers]] in the town above their dark burial place. Their [[Fiyr remains|remains]] can be cremated with [[magic pyre logs]], [[ironwood pyre logs]], [[redwood pyre logs]] or [[rosewood pyre logs]] as part of the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton minigame]], requiring a [[Firemaking]] level of 80, 85, 95, and 97 respectively. 

As with all [[Shades (Shades of Mort'ton)|shades in Mort'ton]], Fiyr shades possess 2 traits you should be aware of:

# A unique trait in which their [[Damage per second/Melee#Step seven: Calculate the hit chance|failed accuracy rolls]] do not count as combat; therefore actions usually restricted during combat can still be performed should this occur. Note that this also affects auto-retaliate, however they can still [[Successful_hit|successfully hit a 0]].
# A 1/20 chance to temporarily lower a player's [[Strength]] by 1 on a successful hit that inflicts damage, which can stack.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1698259314773733573|date=3 September 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97631|archivedate=4 September 2023|quote=[Do shades in morton and the shades catacombs have a chance to drain strength? (...)] It's 1/20 if they're hitting >0 damage.}}.

As Fiyr Shades are undead, they are susceptible to the effects of [[Crumble Undead]] and the [[Salve amulet]]. They are also weak to the [[Gadderhammer]], although a [[dragon scimitar]] deals more damage on average.
